sloka: अन्या तु विकटा नाम लम्बमानपयोधरा ।अब्रवीत्कुपिता सीतां मुष्टिमुद्यम्य गर्जती ।। ५.२२.२३।।।।
transliteration: anyā tu vikaṭā nāma lambamānapayodharā ।abravītkupitā sītāṁ muṣṭimudyamya garjatī ।। 5.22.23।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Janaki, the lord of demons, Ravana looked at her with his cruel eyes opened wide and rolling.
